paper_title: Constraints on axions from patchy screening of the cosmic microwave background
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, 95% CL one-tailed upper limit, exactly as plotted on y-axis
notes: First measurement of cross-correlation between axion-induced CMB patchy screening (Planck NPIPE NILC maps) and unWISE Blue galaxies. No signal detected; 95% CL upper limit g_agamma <~ 2e-12 GeV^-1 for 1e-13 eV <~ m_a <~ 1e-12 eV, encoded as a flat two-point bound over the stated validity range. The actual exclusion curve (Fig. 3) has mild mass dependence, but only the summary value is given numerically in text. Not a dark matter search (CMB photons converting in halo magnetic fields), so no local DM density assumed. Profiled over masses 1e-13 to 4e-12 eV, but the quoted bound applies to 1e-13 to 1e-12 eV. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.8, 39)) | Vision: Fig. 3 of arXiv:2409.10514: red region = 95% upper limit on g_agamma from cross-correlation of axion-induced CMB screening (Planck) with unWISE Blue galaxies. Constraint does NOT assume axions are dark matter (signal from resonant CMB photon-axion conversion in galactic halos), hence dm_density_assumed = null. Boundary traced within calibrated axes x: 1e-13 to 4e-12 eV, y: 5e-13 to 2e-10 GeV^-1. Left/right edges of the red region terminate on the CAST bound (~6e-11 GeV^-1). Abstract cross-check: g < 2e-12 GeV^-1 for 1e-13 < m_a < 1e-12 eV, consistent with traced minimum ~1.05e-12 at m_a ~ 3.5e-13 eV.
